description: Nonattainment Area - 8 hr Ozone (2008 Standard) is a dataset listed in BTS National Transportation Atlas Database (NTAD) on geodata.bts.gov, an open geospatial hub of the U.S. transportation atlas, published or maintained by Environmental Protection Agency (EPA). The Nonattainment Area - 8 hr Ozone (2008) dataset was updated on August 31, 2026 by the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) and is part of the U.S. Department of Transportation (USDOT)/Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS) National Transportation Atlas Database (NTAD). This dataset provides detailed information about areas identified in the U.S. Coverage: United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Environmental Protection Agency (EPA). Its keywords are environment, USA, National, NTAD, National Transportation Atlas Database, Transportation, Atlas, Database. The bounding box given is -123.1079,28.8250,-70.4463,43.8925. The hub shows 2026-09-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, not copyrighted, unrestricted public use (as stated on the hub). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ntad-geodata-bts-gov-hub.
